primary_direct_selection: two-fold inner-source validation; maximize grouped geometry, then response Pearson, then minimize MSE
frozen_chain: CorrectLag ridge first-wave prediction plus GeneLevelDense affine transition with training-only alpha selection

claim_scoring.claim_2: PASS iff chain-minus-direct R5 geometry >=0.05 and paired repeat-bootstrap CI lower bound >0
claim_scoring.claim_3: PASS iff residual chain-minus-direct geometry >=0.05 and paired repeat-bootstrap CI lower bound >0
claim_scoring.claim_4: PASS iff oracle-W23 chain-minus-direct geometry >=0.05 and CI lower bound >0; PARTIAL iff point delta >0 or an earlier oracle entry clears the gate
claim_scoring.claim_5: PASS iff fused-minus-direct geometry >=0.05 with CI lower bound >0; PARTIAL iff fusion improves response Pearson or residual correction alignment is positive with nonredundant errors
claim_scoring.claim_6: PASS iff any claimed propagation advantage clears the grouped artifact-safe success standard

strict_boundaries: Held-out sources are absent at every timepoint from fitting and selection
All perturbations in a held-out group use one fitted model
Previous completed result directories are read-only
No GPU model, new architecture, Markov retuning, or CD4 analysis
